Remark
[Interpretation of the first dimension-reduction criterion] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0075 ↗ thm:chow-iii-dimension-reduction-one 1. ch18:18.18\group Dimension Reduction

The hypotheses give curvature control on large balls centered relatively far from the origin, together with an injectivity-radius bound. Since $r_i\to \infty $, the resulting limit is a blow-down limit.
